provenance: docs/design/completed/build-model-stage-d-filing-native-rekey-plan-2026-08-18.md §4.3 / step D-3, over docs/reference/filing-native-data-vs-build-model-structure-2026-08-17.md §4 and the governing design §6.2. Seeded from the two living structure sources and nothing else: the generic template stamp map (schema/templates/template_builder_config_generic.py DATA_CONCEPT_MAP_GENERIC, one stamped item per row) and the structure fields of schema/templates/data_taxonomy.json (the row and its statement plane, plus the two optionality fields). A role exists for every taxonomy row that states a statement plane or carries a template stamp; the six rows that do neither are the market/valuation observation class (plan §4.5), out of this plane by declaration. Nothing routing-, tag- or source-shaped is taken: those fields stay where they are until the pin-construction policy and the producer-side synonym data claim them (plan §4.4). Authored per template kind, never per ticker. Step D-4.1 merged the second authored role-to-item store into these rows — the deleted schema/model_kind_role_catalog.py, itself Stage A's absorption of the two retired hand maps that bound statement and schedule roles before it — as two further binding namespaces: population_items, the compiled items statement and schedule population plus the identity fill bind for a role the template stamp does not carry, and hff_fact_items, the exact compiled items the accepted-HFF fact channel lands a role's disclosed filing-note balance on. The four namespaces are distinct planes of one role and are never pooled: the same role legitimately binds different items on different planes, which is how a disclosed note balance seeds its schedule without double counting the face-statement row that presents it.
